objs.name: document
objs.description: Central object representing documents managed in DHC VISION, including properties, content editing, versioning, release, distribution and archiving.

attributes.name: type_number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number per document type included in the document name

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Areas where the document is valid

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications related to the document (Master data)

attributes.name: distribution_list
attributes.description: Distribution groups or persons informed about release or acknowledgement

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person responsible for releasing the document to readers

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Level 1 document type: Policies contain company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guidelines
objs.description: Level 2 document type: Guidelines document regulations and instructions, describing locally defined regulations or process-related regulations.

objs.name: procedural_instructions
objs.description: Level 3 document type: Procedural Instructions describe the specific procedures within a framework or processes and their details.

objs.name: work_instructions
objs.description: Level 4 document type: Work Instructions document detailed steps, often relevant to specific departments, sometimes including forms/checklists.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: An information object that can be attached to a document to provide additional content or metadata.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled documents attached to the main document; attachments have their own versioning and may affect the main document version.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: An additional information attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

evts.name: attachment_of_new_information_object
evts.description: Attach a new information object to a document.

evts.name: attachment_of_new_document_object
evts.description: Attach a new document object to the system (document creation).

evts.name: define_document_template
evts.description: Define one or more templates for a document type.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit the content of a document.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save document changes; the document is saved.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Convert the saved document to PDF for web display.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Create a new editing version when content or properties change.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Initiate and complete the release process for a document.

evts.name: assign_authorizations
evts.description: Assign authorizations and release participants.

evts.name: create_change_proposals
evts.description: Create change proposals for documents.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Extend the validity period of a document.

evts.name: override
evts.description: Override (AKS) a document by declaring it invalid and archiving.

evts.name: reactivate
evts.description: Reactivate archived or invalidated documents.

evts.name: distribute_document
evts.description: Distribute a document to distribution lists or individuals.

evts.name: acknowledge_distribution
evts.description: Request acknowledgement from distribution recipients.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content into another language with separate workflow.

evts.name: link_documents
evts.description: Link a document to other documents by references.

evts.name: attach_additional_information
evts.description: Attach additional information not subject to the main release.

evts.name: attach_equipment
evts.description: Attach equipment or attachments to the document; attachments are controlled and may affect the main document version.

evts.name: set_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients the document is visible in a multi-client system.

o2o.description: Attachment of information object to document.
Attachment used as equipment for document.

o2e.description: Document is affected by attachments of information object.
New information object is attached to a document.
New document object attachment in system.
